name: Pumpkins
description: Pumpkin pie, and pumpkins you can grow. A pie is a pumpkin, sugar and an egg, anywhere they fit, and heals as a cooked porkchop does. With the world rule Pumpkins Spread on, a pumpkin standing on grass or dirt now and then grows another on open grass nearby, or on grass under a layer of snow, until there are about six around it: one pumpkin makes a patch in a few in-game days spent near it, and a patch you leave one pumpkin of fills again. Tall grass and flowers are left alone. The rule starts off (More Faithful starts its new worlds with it on): switch it on from the mod's page in the settings with the world open, or on Create World's World Rules... page.
